summary: Restrict task search to active workspace
description: A user belongs to two companies and reports task names appearing across workspace boundaries. Correct the workspace search scope.
Product requests a shortcut to switch between workspaces without opening settings. The shortcut has not been chosen.

summary: Show workspace switcher with last-used workspaces
description: Add a quick switcher that preserves workspace isolation and lists recent workspaces.
Users are accepting team invitations long after they were sent. Implement the documented expiry and rejection behavior.
Introduce automatic reminder emails for invitations that have not been accepted. Reminder cadence has not been approved.
Allow admins to resend outstanding invitations while preserving the existing acceptance rules.
Implement protection against repeated invalid password attempts using the product security rules.
Add passkeys as an alternative to password login. The baseline does not define enrollment policy.
Warn authenticated users shortly before their session expires from inactivity.

summary: Prevent removal of final workspace owner
description: The workspace membership screen currently lets a sole owner remove their owner role. Apply the documented safeguard.
Customers request configurable roles beyond the four built-in roles. No permission editor is specified.
Display the capabilities of each documented workspace role in an admin-only comparison view.
API clients are still changing tasks after the parent project was archived. Enforce the documented project lifecycle behavior.
Allow a manager to duplicate an entire project configuration. The cloning scope is unspecified.
Guide a manager through activating a newly created draft project.
Observers can currently change task fields in a project. Match project permissions to the published access rules.
Let an external reviewer access a project for a limited period. The baseline does not define the expiration rule for non-guest project roles.
Display active membership usage when a manager invites another team member.
A STORY moves to READY without acceptance criteria. Apply required task-field validation.
Product requests a SPIKE ticket type. Its behavior has not been specified.

summary: Create task form with type-specific hints
description: Display explanatory hints for STORY and BUG creation while retaining existing validations.
The board lets a task jump straight from BACKLOG to DONE. Implement the authorized workflow graph.
Allow a manager to approve a group of IN_REVIEW tasks in one action. Partial-failure behavior is undefined.
When the user cannot finish a task, show the documented state-transition restriction.
An assignee was removed from a project but open tasks still point to their user account. Apply the reassignment policy.
Support multiple people being accountable for one task. The ownership semantics need a product decision.
Allow contributors to claim unassigned tasks from a project board.
Non-managers are currently able to set P0-CRITICAL. Apply the documented priority permission.
Increase task priority when a due date gets close. Escalation thresholds are not documented.
Add an inline help panel when a manager assigns critical priority.
A pair of teams created a circular BLOCKS chain that cannot be completed. Implement dependency cycle validation.
Customers want to mark tasks in different workspaces as blocking each other. Authorization and visibility requirements are unspecified.
Present blocking tasks before allowing a task to enter DONE.

summary: Allow editing task estimates before Done
description: Users should be able to maintain time estimates on work in progress without rewriting logged actual hours.
Suggest task estimates based on historical work. There is no approved estimation algorithm.
Display overdue status on task cards using the documented time-zone rules.
Parent tasks are being marked DONE while children remain open. Enforce the documented completion constraint.
Users request subtasks nested under other subtasks. The supported nesting depth is not decided for the new feature.
Show completed versus unfinished child tasks on the parent task card.
A task accepts unlimited project labels. Apply the published label cap.
Add user-configurable colors to labels. The baseline defines label names but no color behavior.
Allow project managers to edit the definitions of supported custom fields.
Allow authors to edit their own comments according to the normative business rule while retaining audit history.
Add emoji reactions to task comments. The allowed reactions and counting rules are undefined.
When a user is mentioned in a comment, notify people who currently have access to that task.
An attachment becomes downloadable before scanning finishes. Enforce the documented download gate.
Product wants inline video previews in task files. Supported formats and size policy are unspecified.
Display quarantine and scanning status in the file panel while observing upload policy.
Sprint managers are creating six-week iterations. Enforce documented start-end duration constraints.
Create new planned sprints automatically every few weeks. No recurrence rule exists.
Warn managers when estimated work exceeds advisory sprint capacity.
When a sprint completes, ensure unfinished tasks follow the documented rollover behavior.
Customers ask to reopen a completed sprint to change scope. New authorization and history rules are undefined.
Display historical commitment values after a manager completes a sprint.

summary: Require authorization to persist backlog order
description: Contributors are saving their private drag order as the shared project backlog sequence. Enforce manager authorization.
Provide an AI-generated sort order for the backlog. No ranking criteria are specified.
Let managers change persistent backlog ordering in a drag-and-drop view.

summary: Protect board counts by project permission
description: Project board counts currently include work the viewer cannot access. Correct the visibility filter.
Let managers create arbitrary columns in addition to state-based ones. The column mapping is not defined.
Managers can publish project-wide saved views using supported filter fields.

summary: Enable in-app notifications for eligible users
description: Task mentions and assignments need reliable in-app notifications with correct recipient access.
Add a daily digest of task changes. Neither delivery time nor contents are approved.
Add a settings control for email alerts on mentions while preserving the normative default.

summary: Write audit records for assignee changes
description: When a task changes owner, keep the required activity history with actor and subject details.
Allow contributors to export their workspace-wide audit history. Access scope is not specified.
Let authorized contributors read the activity history on tasks they can access.

summary: Prevent unauthorized matches in task search
description: Search results leak task titles from restricted projects. Enforce current membership filtering.
Introduce semantic task search across textual content. There is no approved embedding or relevance policy.
Allow search by supported facets including project, state and assignee.

summary: Compute cycle time from workflow events
description: The cycle-time dashboard currently starts counting at task creation rather than work start. Apply the documented metric.
Show projected sprint completion based on prior velocities. The prediction method is undefined.
Display as_of alongside derived project reports to clarify freshness.
An entry permits negative time or more than a full day. Apply the defined worklog range.
Start and stop effort timers from task cards. Pause and idle-time rules are not described.
Allow later corrections with the existing manager reason requirement.

summary: Prevent incomplete milestones from showing complete
description: A milestone is marked complete while linked work is still open. Apply the documented completion rule.
Require approvals before a release can be published. Reviewer roles are not defined.
Display the task list captured at the time a release was published.
External guests can edit project tasks through the API. Enforce read-only guest policy.
Create shareable public project links that do not require accounts. Visibility and expiration are unspecified.
Display the configured expiry date on the guest membership panel.

summary: Keep existing tasks unchanged after template edits
description: A manager updates a task template and existing generated tasks are unexpectedly modified. Enforce non-retroactive behavior.
Allow users to publish templates usable by all company workspaces. Sharing permissions are not defined.

summary: Support task creation from a template
description: Instantiate templates with new stable task keys and enforce required custom fields.
Project export downloads remain accessible indefinitely. Implement the published link expiration rule.
Product requests automatic recurring project exports. The retention and delivery destination are undefined.
Support restoring a recently archived project under the documented administrator rules.
Outgoing webhook requests need verifiable signatures and stable event IDs as documented.
Allow several endpoints for one webhook subscription. Ordering semantics are undefined.
Show recent failed delivery status and scheduled retry details for admins.
A deactivated user can still perform actions with a previously issued token. Apply deactivation semantics.
Let projects configure their own audit retention period. Allowed minimums and maximums are unspecified.
Display a safe progress and final status for a workspace deletion request.
A modified browser request can submit an OWNER role in its payload. Enforce trusted server-side authorization.
Require a second administrator to approve sensitive exports. Approval rules are not documented.
Show actionable retry guidance when an API operation is rate limited.

summary: Reject partial imports on invalid mappings
description: An import contains unmapped statuses yet creates some tasks. Implement all-or-nothing mandatory validation.
Customers request calculated fields in imported spreadsheets. Formula evaluation and safety rules are undefined.
Display errors for invalid keys and unknown assignees before committing an import.
The workflow currently depends on drag-and-drop, preventing keyboard-only users from moving tasks.
Add three selectable high-contrast themes. The exact palette and persistence behavior are unspecified.
Translate UI text without altering stable API status codes.
A FREE workspace continues activating projects beyond its plan allowance. Apply published quota enforcement.
Let workspaces temporarily exceed paid-plan quotas during an upgrade. No grace duration is specified.
Display active projects and active members to owners and admins only.
Renaming a workspace currently breaks links to existing task and sprint resources. Preserve the documented immutable resource identity.
Allow a workspace owner to upload an organization avatar. No asset policy or dimensions are specified.
A cancelled workspace invitation is still accepted by an old link. Enforce the cancellation rule.
Allow admins to resend all pending invitations at once. No throttling decision is documented.
A rotated refresh token can be reused without ending its session. Apply the session security policy.
Add a remember-me checkbox to login. The persistence policy is undefined.
A GUEST can open workspace-wide analytics despite restricted role grants. Apply access restrictions.
Let members request promotion to ADMIN. The approval process is unspecified.

summary: Keep project key stable after first task
description: Renaming a project key breaks existing task identifiers. Protect the published immutability constraint.
Automatically archive long-inactive projects. The inactivity threshold is unspecified.

summary: Enforce project membership for contributor reads
description: A workspace member accesses a project without explicit membership. Restrict project reads according to membership.
Allow a user to request access when a project link is restricted. No approver workflow is defined.
A BUG goes into the backlog with no reproduction details and no explanation. Implement the documented validation.
Suggest a title from the task description during creation. The generation format is not specified.
A manager reopens DONE work without a reason. Apply the documented reopen constraint.
Introduce approval requests for contributors who want to reopen DONE tasks. The approver is unspecified.
After task reassignment, the new assignee should receive the documented in-app event.
Automatically assign unassigned tasks to eligible contributors. No fairness rule is specified.

summary: Keep priority change independent of sprint
description: Changing task priority should not silently alter a task's sprint assignment or state.
Show an escalation timer on critical bugs. The response target is not approved.

summary: Reject Done when blockers remain open
description: A task with an unfinished incoming BLOCKS dependency is being completed. Apply its completion restriction.
Notify followers when an upstream blocking task changes. Notification recipients are undefined.
Task cards show overdue status based on the viewer's browser time zone. Apply project-local scheduling rules.
Recompute task estimates when subtasks are added. No aggregation rule is documented.
Users can create grandchildren under subtasks. Enforce the published hierarchy limit.
Convert arbitrary checklist items into subtasks. Duplicate handling is unspecified.

summary: Limit custom-field definition changes to managers
description: Contributors can change project-wide custom-field schemas. Enforce the manager permission rule.
Offer shared labels across all workspace projects. Ownership of label edits is undefined.
Editing a comment currently overwrites the old content without any version metadata. Apply audit requirements.
Translate task comments automatically on read. Language-choice behavior is unspecified.
The file API accepts task attachments above the documented maximum. Reject oversized uploads.
Compress images attached to tasks to lower storage costs. Target dimensions are undefined.
Sprint scheduling currently blocks task assignment when estimated capacity is exceeded. Apply the advisory-only policy.
Adjust sprint dates around holidays. The holiday calendar source is unspecified.
A project has more than one ACTIVE sprint. Enforce the documented one-active-sprint rule.
Automatically complete sprints at their end date. The execution policy is unspecified.
A manager adds work during an active sprint but no scope-change event is recorded. Add the required audit event.
Limit the number of ready tasks in a backlog. The threshold is missing.

summary: Require transition validation for drag actions
description: Dragging a card between board columns bypasses the task API transition checks. Enforce documented behavior.
Add dependency-based swimlanes to the board. Grouping behavior has not been defined.
A notification still contains confidential task text after a user's project access is revoked. Apply payload security policy.
Send a weekly summary to project teams. Its audience and schedule are undecided.
The admin panel can rewrite previously recorded audit events. Restrict modifications as documented.
Introduce a signed audit log digest. Signing cadence is unspecified.
Quoted search terms are matching nonadjacent words. Enforce documented contiguous phrase behavior.
Notify users when new tasks match a saved search. Delivery frequency is undefined.
Reports lack a way to tell users when metrics were computed. Include documented freshness metadata.
Create a performance score combining cycle time and throughput. No formula is approved.
A contributor edits an old worklog without manager correction authority. Enforce the author edit window.
Support billable versus nonbillable worklogs. The default is undefined.

summary: Visualize sprint overlap in planning calendar
description: Display existing sprint dates with no overlaps as required by sprint creation rules, plus a warning when dates are being edited.

summary: Add audit export screen for admin
description: Give authorized admins an audit history view with the documented security boundary.

summary: Expose scoped search results in workspace header
description: Add a global quick search that never reveals task titles the user cannot access.

summary: Add a sprint dashboard landing page
description: Show existing supported sprint metrics and a last-updated timestamp.
Explain that in-app notifications exist for eligible events and let users configure their email preferences.
Authentication sessions are expiring at different inactivity thresholds in different clients. Implement one consistent threshold.

summary: Align session-expiry banner with security policy
description: The web app warning banner and server session controller use different inactivity limits. Align their behaviors.

summary: Write acceptance tests for session expiry
description: QA needs a single deterministic idle-session expiry test for the next release.
Support needs the official idle logout duration for the account help page.
The comment edit action is enabled for different durations across the product specifications.
The button is visible in one client for an hour and in another for only half an hour.

summary: Unify API validation for stale comment edits
description: Comment update endpoints and help text disagree about how late an author may edit.
QA has two contradictory documents for the allowed author edit interval.
Implement the initial value of the mention-email checkbox for newly registered accounts.
The onboarding screen describes the mention-email default but normative rules and support answers disagree.
The first-login preference record is initialized differently in the frontend and notification worker.
QA requires the expected out-of-box mention-email behavior to be agreed.
Project restore eligibility is inconsistent between product rules and support FAQ.
The restore action disappears earlier in one client than described in the help center.
The API needs one accepted maximum age for restoration requests.
Publish the official recovery window for archived projects.

summary: Choose task priority when creating from template
description: A task template specifies P1-HIGH but template instantiation is documented as P2-NORMAL by default.

summary: Align template priority selector initial value
description: The template creation flow and the task form disagree about the initial priority after selecting a template.
QA must test a task generated from a template that includes a non-P2 priority.
Documentation describes two different default behaviors for tasks instantiated from templates.
On the project task list, replace the exact button text "New task" with "Create task" in English. Keep click behavior, placement and permissions unchanged.

summary: Add explicit confirmation title to archive dialog
description: Change the title of the existing archive confirmation dialog to "Archive project?". Keep body text and buttons unchanged.
For the sidebar toggle icon button, add aria-label="Expand navigation" when collapsed and aria-label="Collapse navigation" when expanded. Do not alter layout.
When a sprint contains no tasks, display exactly "No tasks in this sprint yet." in the existing empty-state text component.
On Account > Notifications, replace breadcrumb "Alerts" with "Notifications". Do not change URL routing.
In the task comment editor, change the placeholder to "Write a comment...". Preserve submission behavior and validation.

summary: Make project key readonly after task creation
description: For an existing project with at least one task, display the project key as read-only on the settings page. Show the helper text "Project keys cannot be changed after task creation."

summary: Show minutes unit next to effort input
description: On the worklog form, append a static "minutes" unit label to the existing duration input. Do not change data format.
For task cards marked overdue, set the accessible label to "Task is overdue" without changing badge logic.
Change the export jobs page heading from "Downloads" to "Project exports" for all supported locales using the existing localization key.

summary: Change webhook delivery history empty message
description: When there are no webhook delivery attempts, display "No delivery attempts recorded." in the history panel.
Set the search input clear-button tooltip to "Clear search". Clicking it must continue to empty the current query.
When the session is already invalid and a login screen is shown, display the toast "Your session has expired. Please sign in again." Do not change timeout logic.
In task detail, change the archived status icon title attribute to "Archived task". Preserve the current icon.
On a release with state PUBLISHED, show tooltip "This release has been published." Do not add new actions.
On the board filter menu, rename "Remove filters" to "Reset filters". Clicking it must continue to clear selected filters.
On a guest membership record, show the badge text "Guest · Read-only". Do not grant or remove permissions.
In the import preview, rename the warnings subsection heading to "Warnings (non-blocking)"; keep validation behavior unchanged.
On each report header, display "Data as of" before the existing as_of timestamp. Preserve the stored value and formatting.
For an uploaded file pending antivirus scanning, replace current placeholder with "Scanning attachment...". Do not allow downloads until scanning finishes.
